game_title: Continue Gate – Torchlit Cave Mouth Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth, the torchlit cave entrance: the torchbearer must handle giant bats while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Continue Gate: Use continue to skip spoiled crystal shards but keep the loop running.
theme: Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth: the torchlit cave entrance
core_gameplay_loop: In Torchlit Cave Mouth, repeat each round: Use continue to skip spoiled crystal shards but keep the loop running. Each round, giant bats strike the lantern post, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the skipped_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the lantern post from giant bats in Torchlit Cave Mouth: keep the skipped_ok meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 45-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: skipped_ok drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 45-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 6 (applied tier): Continue Gate
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how skipped_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant bats in Torchlit Cave Mouth.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 45 seconds while skipped_ok > 0.
